tasks.label: Hydraulic: Build (Fabric)
tasks.detail: Compiles the Fabric module (Hydraulic + embedded Geyser + test companion mod).

tasks.label: Hydraulic: Start Dev Server (Fabric)
tasks.detail: Real Test A path: Fabric dev server + Hydraulic + embedded Geyser (Bedrock UDP 19132, Java TCP 25565). Do not run 'Hydraulic: Run Runtime Pipeline Tests' concurrently - Loom's runServer blocks the invoking Gradle process and a second gradlew invocation can block on the project lock until this server stops.

tasks.label: Hydraulic: Start Dev Server (Fabric, Debug)
tasks.detail: Same as 'Start Dev Server (Fabric)' but opens JDWP port 5005 and pauses startup for 'Attach: Fabric Dev Server'.

tasks.label: Hydraulic: Start Dev Server (NeoForge) [experimental]
tasks.detail: EXPERIMENTAL/best-effort: neoforge/build.gradle.kts has a known '// TODO fix neoforge runServer task' comment. Not part of the default compound task.

tasks.label: Bedrock: Start BDS (optional)
tasks.detail: Test B (optional, independent of Phlodgate validation): runs dev/bedrock/bedrock_server.exe on port 19133 if present, else prints setup instructions and exits cleanly.

tasks.label: Hydraulic: Run Runtime Pipeline Tests
tasks.detail: Component-level tests with a mocked Geyser boundary (SyncPlannerTest, GeyserSyncTransportTest, TransferBridgeRuntimeTest, RuntimeDispatchTableTest, CompatibilityRuntimeDiagnosticsTest, etc.) - NOT a live client trace. Do not run while a dev server gradlew invocation is still active. Running this and 'Run Pack Validation Tests' as two separate gradlew invocations clobbers each other's JUnit XML in shared/build/test-results/test; use 'Run All Focused Integration Tests' if you need both.

tasks.label: Hydraulic: Run Pack Validation Tests
tasks.detail: Runs PackValidatorTest, PackValidationTrackerTest, and neighboring pack unit tests. Do not run while a dev server gradlew invocation is still active. Running this and 'Run Runtime Pipeline Tests' as two separate gradlew invocations clobbers each other's JUnit XML in shared/build/test-results/test; use 'Run All Focused Integration Tests' if you need both.

tasks.label: Hydraulic: Run All Focused Integration Tests
tasks.detail: Runs both focused test filters in a single :shared:test invocation. Gradle clears shared/build/test-results/test on each run, so this must stay one invocation rather than two sequential/parallel gradlew calls, or one filter's JUnit XML wipes the other's. Requires no live dev server.

tasks.label: Hydraulic: Validate Runtime Artifacts
tasks.detail: Read-only check that CompatibilityHandoffQueue/Exporter wrote at least one envelope to fabric/run/config/hydraulic/cache/handoff-queue/exports. Safe to run while the dev server is active.

tasks.label: Hydraulic: Validate Generated Packs
tasks.detail: Read-only check of fabric/run/config/hydraulic/reports/pack-validation-report.json's perMod validity. Safe to run while the dev server is active.

tasks.label: Hydraulic: Write Integration Test Report
tasks.detail: Aggregates JUnit results + latest handoff envelope + pack validation into config/hydraulic/reports/integration-test-report.json. bedrockClientCheck is always left PENDING_MANUAL_CLIENT_CHECK.

tasks.label: Hydraulic: Print Manual Bedrock Check
tasks.detail: Prints the required manual Bedrock-client verification steps; CLIENT_OBSERVED is never automated.

tasks.label: Bedrock: Register Phlodgate Server (deep link)
tasks.detail: Best-effort minecraft:// deep link to register 127.0.0.1:19132 with the installed Bedrock client. Manual fallback: add the server in-game if this does not work.

tasks.label: Bedrock: Publish Multi-Platform Attestation Matrix
tasks.detail: Publishes a comprehensive multi-platform Bedrock client observation matrix (Windows 11, iOS, Android, Switch) for Level 4 validation.

tasks.label: Bedrock: Record Client Observation Attestation
tasks.detail: Records a physical Bedrock client observation attestation into config/hydraulic/reports/client-observation-attestations.json for Level 4 validation.

tasks.label: Phlodgate: Launch Full Integration Test
tasks.detail: Build -> start Fabric dev server -> validate artifacts/packs -> write report -> print manual Bedrock client check. Run 'Hydraulic: Run All Focused Integration Tests' separately, before starting or after stopping the dev server.
